items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: And then the next year I made my debut and Puron played all of our parties.

ctx.x: I moved to New Orange when I was three. And the first time I remember anything about jazz was at Pascha Chien, this small Negro band called the Watson Brothers. Started off at homemade instruments and they finally, by going around and serenading people in the evening, and people would go out and either pay them because they liked it or pay them to get away. They managed to acquire enough money to buy a few little, I think they had a banjo and a guitar. I don't remember exactly all the various things that they did…

Well, do you remember what your parents, your friends' parents thought about it, and what your friends thought about it when it first started, you haven't heard it when it first started becoming acceptable?
